day name: The Commemoration of the Consecration of the Holy Resurrection Patriarchal Cathedral
name: Florus and Laurus
specialDismissal: Who, for us implemented everything according to His plan, and willed the Cathedral built in Kyiv to be consecrated in honour of His Resurrection,
troparia: (Tone 4) As the priceless beauty residing within the divine image of the tabernacle,* thus outwardly you manifested the holy glory of your temple O Lord.* Establish it for the ages of ages, and accept, through the prayers of the Theotokos, our supplications,* which we unceasingly offer to You, O Life and Resurrection of all.
kontakia: (Tone 4) The Synaxis of the faithful in the Cathedral of the Resurrection,* shines as a multitude of stars in heavens,* and as we offer our prayers we exclaim:* “This is the house the Lord has made.”
